name: io.github.edvyno/akari-x402
description: Akari x402 tools: funding-edge + token-safety previews, service list, paid 402 call helper.

environmentVariables.name: AKARI_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Base wallet private key used only by paid_call to sign EIP-3009 payments. Omit for free tools.

environmentVariables.name: AKARI_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard per-call spend cap enforced before signing (default 1.00).

environmentVariables.name: AKARI_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Override the origin URL (default: the desk's stable Akash ingress).
